checks: Staged worker units do not start implicitly; explicit state initialization and adoption are distinct.
Native admission adopts historical SQLite including enrolment and MIME bytes without inventing approval or replacing data.
An invented confirmed adult request provisions one real Kanidm person, exact mail, one SQL account and one broker principal via UID947 peer socket; no person exists before confirmation.
The enrolment link is valid against real Kanidm; its durable message has the exact recipient and survives restart unchanged. Invitation use remains one.
A missing broker or native provider leaves a durable retriable stage; process restart completes that same request without duplicate person, account, invitation or message.
Native cycle reads mail from real Kanidm, queues a notice and never starts the 30-day deadline on SMTP refusal; explicit synthetic receipt permits the deadline.

Deletion and closure preserve content before archive acknowledgement. Explicit synthetic archive acknowledgement permits only the selected content to be erased; replay after interruption is idempotent and preserves an unrelated account.
Wrong credentials, wrong issuer, malformed requests and wrong socket UID cannot grant effect; synthetic credentials, subjects, mail and enrolment are absent from worker diagnostics.
not_claimed: Real Proton delivery: compiled public CA trust is retained; acknowledgements used for business time travel are explicit synthetic fixture events
Off-host archive durability when its receipt is simulated
Protected forge approval or production readiness
